feather_token.name: Feather Token
feather_token.lore: Weightless. The Feather Offering in the Updraft Court wants it.

gale_key.name: Gale Key
gale_key.lore: Opens the wind-sealed door to the Eye of the Gale.

onDone.text: Chains rattle across the chasm. The first skybridge span drops into place.

onStep.text: The winch clanks. Throw the other lever.

mechanics.jam: The winch is jammed. The near lever first.

waves.say: The vanes spin. Something comes down the wind.

onDone.text: The wind lets go. A Feather Token drifts onto the plate.
The vanes lock into the wind. A gate far below the ring slides open in the south wall.

mechanics.doneText: The vanes settle into the wind.

onOpen.text: A draught blows a niche open in the east wall.

mechanics.hint: A cushion of white wool, shaped to hold a feather.
mechanics.verb: lays the feather on the wool and a draught opens the wall.

onOpen.text: The wind-door to the Eye of the Gale opens.

mechanics.hint: A door of still air held in a quartz frame, a keyhole in its centre.
mechanics.verb: turns the Gale Key and the door of held wind lets go.

encounters.say: Wind howls through the colonnade. Shapes circle in the gale.
The updraft roars up through the middle. Three vane levers sit on the ring gallery far above.

bosses.name: The Gale Warden
bosses.intro: The Gale Warden spins up from the eye. Snuff the three wind-lanterns on the pillars to ground it.
bosses.deathText: The Gale Warden unravels into a last gust.

shield.breakText: The lanterns gutter out! Strike the Warden now!
shield.relapseText: The wards reform and The Gale Warden calls its servants.

completion.intro: The Gale Eyrie. Cross the skybridge and ride the updraft.
completion.message: The wind settles. The eyrie closes shortly.
